The '''Space Monkey Café''' was a bar in the city of [[Bayonard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
The café consisted of a glass and [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] lounge located on top of a three-story tower. Beneath it were kitchens, storage rooms and rooms that were available for rent. It had a high turnover of staff and had a resident band, the [[Space Monkeys]], who gave regular performances.

==History==
By about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Chelsey Grimes]] had became the café's manager. [[Adran Blake]] worked there as a cook, while the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Maureen]] worked at the bar. [[Selima DeWitt]], the daughter of the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of Bayonard, was a regular patron of the café. When she went missing, the [[heroes of Cularin]] were hired to find her, and they visited the café to see if they could find any clues about what had happened to her. While there, they spoke to [[Narask]] and [[Tyburn Welles]], two associates of DeWitt.
